prompt:
CONCEPT: a female personification of Dong Zhuo (동탁), a ruler of the rival warlords in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms — the tyrant who burned Luoyang and fell by her own excess. Reimagined as a woman; her costume, ornaments, colours and bearing carry her famous deeds and temperament. This is a character design, not a historical portrait.
STYLE: Premium Korean MMORPG promotional character render — an in-engine 3D character model with hand-painted textures, not flat cel shading and not a 2D anime illustration: semi-realistic volumetric forms, porcelain skin with a soft subsurface glow and glossy specular highlights, a small refined face with delicate realistic-anime features, long legs and a narrow waist on a full, curvaceous figure — soft, rounded volume at bust, hips and thighs in the body type SILHOUETTE names; never thin, flat or boyishly straight. Polished metal, silk and gems catch sharp highlights. Extremely intricate ornamented costume — filigree metalwork, jewel inlays, layered translucent fabrics and fine embroidery. Character-select-screen lighting: strong rim light, soft key light on the face, drifting light particles, atmospheric depth with a softly blurred background. Luxurious, high-detail finish.
TRAITS of Dong Zhuo to carry in her design and the scene: gluttonous power and cruelty, heavy gold-and-violet armor, a feast of excess, flames of Luoyang.
FACTION — the rival warlords (雄). Palette: royal violet, tarnished gold, bronze, dark crimson.
AGE: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
SILHOUETTE: voluptuous, generously curved at bust, hips and thighs build; an updo bun with no bangs, forehead bare; plum-black hair with a violet sheen.
FACE — she must read as her own person at a glance, NOT the style's default pretty face and not a sister of the other characters: first impression — a glamorous, sultry allure; porcelain-pale skin; delicate V-line face with a small, soft chin; moderately sized, realistically proportioned eyes — soft droopy eyes, outer eye corners tilting sharply upward; low heavy brows; broad soft nose; small bow lips; crimson eyes; rosy flushed cheeks. Whatever the face shape, keep soft, feminine, attractive contours with a small, soft chin — never elongated, horse-like, mannish or heavy-jawed. Face proportions: a short, compact midface — the eyes sit at about the vertical middle of the head and the eyes-to-mouth distance is short; the face is only slightly longer than it is wide (about 1.3 : 1 from hairline to chin), with a small, softly rounded chin. Long bangs, side locks or a tall headpiece frame the face but never make it look longer.
WORLD — THREE KINGDOMS ERA: the chaos of the late Eastern Han, around 184–200 AD: burning Luoyang, the Hulao Pass, Yellow Turban fields, warlord camps of rival banners, frontier steppe and the southern jungles of the Nanman. COSTUME (Three Kingdoms era): Han-dynasty ruler's regalia — layered silk robes in her faction's colours with broad embroidered sleeves, a jade-and-gold guan headpiece or a mian crown with beaded strings, jade pendants at the sash, a ceremonial jian sword at the belt. Authentic late-Han Chinese dress — cross-collared silk robes with wide sleeves and a broad sash, lamellar or scale armor laced with cords where armor is worn, bronze, jade and lacquer ornament, Han court hair ornaments; silk, lacquered leather, bronze and iron. No Western plate armor, no Japanese kimono or samurai armor, no Qing-dynasty dress, no modern material. LIGHT: natural daylight, torches or lanterns, unless TIME & WEATHER says otherwise. Martial-fantasy glamour: silk sashes and ribbons flowing in the wind, a sheer layered skirt, jade and gold jewellery at the hair and waist.
MOOD: bold martial-fantasy key art — high contrast, wind-swept silk and hair, drifting petals and embers, dynamic contrapposto.
EXPOSURE (bold): her robes open to show skin — the cross collar opened into a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders and arms where the outer robe is cut away by design, a high slit in the skirt panels showing the thigh; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
SIGNATURE ITEM: a heavy golden mace — she holds or carries it, drawn at full scale, in the form this WORLD gives it. It is one whole object drawn once: a long weapon (spear, glaive, halberd, staff, bow) keeps a single straight, unbroken shaft from butt to head with exactly one head or blade, held in front of or beside her body — never passing behind her head or shoulders, never broken, bent, split in two by her body or arm, or duplicated; if the frame cuts it, it leaves the frame as one straight line.
EXPRESSION: a faint cool smile, calm composed eyes. Keep it subtle and natural, a light touch rather than acting: no sneer, glare, smirk-pulled cheek or chin lifted to look down at the viewer; her face stays relaxed and attractive.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no horse or other creature, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers, except that a banner, seal or emblem may carry the single character 雄 or 董.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.

observations: 주인공 성인 여성 한 명, 얼굴·목 비율과 볼륨 체형 확인.
머리 하나, 팔 둘, 다리 둘. 보이는 손목·팔꿈치가 해당 어깨로 이어지며 중복 팔다리가 보이지 않음.
세계별 복식 확인, 황금 철퇴는 몸 앞·옆에서 손잡이와 머리가 이어지는 한 자루.
높은 머리 장식 끝이 상단 프레임에 닿아 전신 여백 지시를 완전히 충족하지 않음.
무협풍 복식에 장식성이 강하고 삼국시대 사료 복식의 엄밀한 재현은 아님.
qa.cause: 생성 결과가 일부 구도·좌우 손·크롭·배경 분리·복식 지시를 덜 따름. 지시문은 수정하지 않았으며 허용된 재생성 항목(긴 얼굴·타인 얼굴·마른 체형·끊긴 물건·팔다리 개수)에 해당하는 명확한 오류는 보이지 않음.
